question: Should unreconciled ambiguous outbound delivery entries without adapter reconciliation stay pending/backed off instead of moving to failed/ while the broader delivery-ledger work remains open?
rationale: The code repair is bounded and aligns with the no-blind-replay contract, but the pending-versus-failed outcome affects operator visibility, upgrades with existing rows, and message-delivery recovery policy.

options.title: Accept Pending Deferral
options.body: Merge this mitigation after exact-head checks finish, accepting pending/backoff as the interim state and leaving full reconciliation/UI surfacing to the canonical delivery-consistency issues.

options.title: Require Operator Surfacing First
options.body: Ask for a visible failed-or-action-required surface before merge so users are not left with silent pending rows.

options.title: Pause For Full Reconciliation Design
options.body: Keep this PR open or close it in favor of a broader adapter receipt ledger if maintainers do not want another interim state.

recommendation.title: Accept Pending Deferral
recommendation.body: Merge this mitigation after exact-head checks finish, accepting pending/backoff as the interim state and leaving full reconciliation/UI surfacing to the canonical delivery-consistency issues.
